page.content:
Ensign who engineers Othello's jealousy with a handkerchief and a hint.

How Iago connects

  • Work: Othello — Iago is the ensign who engineers the jealousy plot.
  • Character: Othello (the Moor) — Iago works to destroy Othello's trust in Desdemona.

What is Iago?

Iago is the ancient who says he hates the Moor, uses Cassio and the handkerchief, and refuses to speak a motive once the plot is open.

Key threads lead to Othello and Othello (the Moor).
